name: app-dark-problem-and-solution-cards-slide
title: Black challenge and approach slide with two dark grey cards and dimmed text
whatItIs: A black slide with a small bracket-like logo at the top, tiny corner labels, a large two-tone headline 'Challenge & Approach', and two rounded dark grey cards labelled Problem and Solution with icons and paragraphs where some sentences are dimmed.
whatItMeans: Serious and structured; the dimmed lines build hierarchy without colour.
techniques: Split a slide into two matched dark cards for problem and solution.
Dim secondary sentences to grey inside a paragraph.
Use huge white then grey headline text.
Place labels and icons in the card top corners.

vocabulary.definition: A heading where the second line is dimmed.
Two cards contrasting an issue with its answer.
Grey text inside white text to show lower priority.
Tiny caps text in corners as framing.
